disclaimer: A record of what each source states, not legal advice. Entries marked 'verify' have not been read for this project and must be before publishing.

sources.name: NCI SEER — Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Program
sources.used_for: Incidence, mortality, stage distribution, survival, lifetime risk and median age.
sources.licence: Work of the US federal government — generally public domain.
sources.redistributed: Derived figures only (numbers parsed from the published tables).
sources.note: The SEER API needs a government account; this project reads the open Cancer Stat Facts pages instead, which need no key.

sources.name: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics
sources.used_for: Alteration frequencies per subtype and per cohort node, the concordance matrix and mutation hotspots with protein positions.
sources.licence: Portal software is open source; the underlying study data carries the terms of its originating consortium.
sources.redistributed: Derived counts (n/N per gene per subtype). No patient-level data.
sources.note: Studies read: crc_msk_2017, coadread_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, crc_eo_2020, coad_silu_2022. Each carries the terms of its originating consortium.

sources.name: UniProt Knowledgebase (Swiss-Prot)
sources.used_for: Protein length, domain architecture, accessions, AlphaFold links.
sources.redistributed: Domain boundaries and protein names, in data/colorectal.targets.js.
sources.note: CC BY requires attribution wherever the data appears — hence the source line in the target drawer, not only in this file.

sources.name: RCSB Protein Data Bank
sources.used_for: Structure metadata (title, method, resolution, ligands) and the rendered structure images shown in the Targets lens.
sources.licence: PDB archive DATA files are free of copyright restrictions (CC0). Images and other content generated by RCSB are published under RCSB's own terms, which are NOT necessarily the same.
sources.redistributed: YES — 21 rendered JPEG images for this dataset under data/img/ (~1246 KB).
sources.note: This is the one place the project redistributes binary third-party content rather than linking to it. An earlier version of this codebase asserted the images were public domain; that conflated the PDB archive with RCSB-generated renders. Read the usage policy before publishing, or switch to linking the images rather than committing them.

sources.name: openFDA drug label API (US FDA Structured Product Labeling)
sources.used_for: Boxed warnings, named warnings and common adverse reactions for 27 of 28 agents, from their US labels.
sources.licence: US federal government resource — generally public domain.
sources.redistributed: Short excerpts of label text, each with its effective date and a link.
sources.note: Missing from this file until 2026-09-14, although every targets overlay already carried label excerpts.

sources.name: CIViC — Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer
sources.used_for: Evidence levels, evidence types and therapy associations per gene, from 755 evidence items.
sources.redistributed: Aggregated counts and level summaries per gene.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov (NIH / NLM)
sources.used_for: Status, phase, sponsor, enrolment and dates for 28 trials, joined to the curated drug rows by NCT id.
sources.licence: US National Library of Medicine resource — generally free to use.
sources.redistributed: Selected registry fields per NCT id.
sources.note: NLM asks that the site is not misrepresented as endorsing a use.

sources.name: Europe PMC (EMBL-EBI)
sources.used_for: The Literature lens: 247 papers since 2024-01-01 — titles, journals, dates, publication types, MeSH headings, preprint flags.
sources.licence: Metadata is reusable under Europe PMC's terms; ABSTRACTS AND FULL TEXT remain under their publishers' copyright.
sources.redistributed: Metadata only. Abstracts are fetched for classification and deliberately NOT written to the overlay.
sources.note: Excluding abstracts is a licensing decision as much as a size one. The app links out for text rather than reproducing it.

sources.name: GWAS Catalog (EMBL-EBI / NHGRI)
sources.used_for: Polygenic risk associations for the trait 'colorectal cancer'.
sources.licence: EMBL-EBI data resources are generally open; confirm the Catalog's own terms.

sources.name: OncoTree (Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center)
sources.used_for: Canonical oncology type codes per node.
sources.licence: Not stated in this project — confirm before redistributing.

sources.name: WHO / IARC Global Cancer Observatory (GLOBOCAN)
sources.used_for: Worldwide incidence and mortality estimates on the Start page.
sources.licence: IARC publishes terms of use for GCO content.
sources.redistributed: Worldwide figures curated by hand in data/colorectal.js.
sources.note: The Start-page numbers the pipeline does not fetch.

sources.name: Curated colorectal drug pipeline
sources.used_for: 28 agent rows with target, modality, company, phase, trial and readout.
sources.licence: Authored by this project's maintainer from public sources.
sources.note: Each row carries its own source_url. Not an external dataset.
